headline: Trader Focus Shifts to Growth Risks as Tech Stock Sell-Off Deepens
summary: Global capital market anxiety shifted from inflation concerns toward slowing growth, with persistent tech declines reducing derivative market bets on Federal Reserve and ECB rate cuts in December.
why: Shift in macroeconomic narrative alters interest rate futures pricing, credit spreads, and asset allocation strategies globally.

impacts.name: US 10-Year Treasury Yield
impacts.why: Growth anxiety recalibrated trader expectations for upcoming monetary policy decisions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Deepening equity sell-offs led investors to reassess central bank monetary policy pathways for year-end meetings.
